subject.title: [Bug]: Slash command error——WebUI treats `/model status` as a model name instead of a slash-command subcommand

question: Should maintainers refresh/adopt the open fork PR, or close it and allow a new narrow replacement PR against the current `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-command-executor.ts` path?
rationale: The fix direction is clear, but a closing PR is still open, conflicting, and not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create a duplicate until that PR path is resolved.

options.title: Adopt or replace the linked fix
options.body: Refresh the same narrow behavior against current files, preserving credit and closing or superseding the conflicting fork PR only after a viable fix exists.

options.title: Ask the contributor to rebase
options.body: Keep the issue and fork PR open while the contributor updates the branch to current paths and adds current tests.

options.title: Leave issue only
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical tracker and defer PR handling, accepting that users still hit the documented command regression.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the linked fix
recommendation.body: Refresh the same narrow behavior against current files, preserving credit and closing or superseding the conflicting fork PR only after a viable fix exists.
